title: The Dead Man Who Fooled Hitler #Shorts

hook.narration: In nineteen forty-three, Britain fooled Hitler with a dead man.

visuals.prompt: A lone briefcase chained to a wrist washing up on a misty Spanish beach at dawn, 1943

scenes.narration: The Allies planned to invade Sicily, and everyone expected it.

visuals.prompt: A 1943 war room with officers around a table map of the Mediterranean, cigarette smoke, dim lamps
Allied landing craft silhouettes on a dark Mediterranean sea

scenes.narration: So British intelligence found a body, gave him a fake identity, Major William Martin, and chained a briefcase of forged papers to him.

visuals.prompt: Two British intelligence officers in a dim London office forging documents under a desk lamp, 1943
A leather briefcase with a chain and a forged identity card on a wooden table, noir lighting

scenes.narration: The papers pointed to an invasion of Greece. The body was set adrift off Spain, where German agents got hold of the documents.

visuals.prompt: A submarine surfacing at night near the Spanish coast, a figure lowering a bundle into the waves
German officers reading secret papers in a candlelit room, tense expressions

scenes.narration: Germany shifted troops away from Sicily. The Allies landed there with less resistance than they feared.

visuals.prompt: German troop columns marching toward Greece along a mountain road, 1943
Allied soldiers wading ashore on a Sicilian beach at dawn

description: Operation Mincemeat was one of the strangest deceptions of World War II: a corpse, a fake identity and a briefcase of forged papers. #Shorts #History #WW2

thumbnail.prompt: A briefcase chained to a wrist on a foggy beach at dawn, cinematic, 1943
